tail:
No fatal or nonfatal defect found in the six assigned items.

Key checks:

- `thm-the-forgetful-functor-from-eilenberg-moore-strictly-creates-all-base-limits`: the proof establishes the unique algebra structure on the supplied apex, unchanged legs, and the lifted universal property—hence strict creation, not merely preservation/reflection. For the empty diagram, terminality makes the empty family jointly monic and supplies the unique structure map. No smallness hypothesis is needed because the theorem is conditional on the particular base limit existing.
- `cor-every-category-monadic-over-set-is-complete`: the library definition explicitly says “complete” means having all small limits. The comparison functor need only be an equivalence; ordinary limit creation across that equivalence transports the Eilenberg–Moore limits back to the source category.
- `thm-eilenberg-moore-creates-base-colimits-preserved-by-the-monad-and-its-square`: repaired step 3.1 is correct and typed:
  \[
  (u a)T(i_j)=u i_j a_j=q_j a_j=xT(q_j)=(xT(u))T(i_j).
  \]
  The family \(T(i_j)\) is jointly epic because \(T\) preserves the colimit. The \(T^2\) hypothesis is load-bearing in step 2.1, where joint epimorphy of \(T^2(i_j)\) proves associativity. For the empty diagram, preservation makes \(TQ\) and \(T^2Q\) initial, so the empty-family arguments remain valid.
- `thm-a-monadic-functor-is-conservative`: if \(g=f^{-1}\), then
  \[
  f(gb)=b=(fa)Tg,
  \]
  so cancellation of \(f\) gives \(gb=aTg\); the inverse is an algebra homomorphism. The non-strict monadic case is handled because the comparison equivalence is fully faithful and \(U=U^TK\) holds on the nose.
- The two definitions agree with their cited dependencies. Strict monadicity implies monadicity, while the converse is expressly not asserted.
- No assigned item depends on an `ai-generated` Statement or Construction.

Boundary pass: empty indexing categories and one-object diagrams were checked explicitly. Zero objects introduce no exception. There are no numerical \(n=0\), \(n=1\), zero-space, endpoint, or nonemptiness parameters. The only equivalence wording is exactly the definition of conservativity; no reverse implication is silently used.

Coverage: I read all six assigned items fully, all eleven distinct direct dependency targets fully, and the library’s separate definition of completeness. I also read both page manifests/prose and sampled the corresponding proof-contract entries. I did not audit the unassigned items on those pages. Nothing in the assigned scope was uncheckable.
